blocks.text:
Breakfast in hotel 

Today we will visit the famous Chapultepec Forest, the green lung of the capital and where we will find a variety of museums to visit. 

Our first visit will be to the Cárcamo Museum, this museum is located in the old building that housed the pumping station known as "El Carcamo de Chapultepec", which was built in the early twentieth century to provide water to Mexico City, the museum has a series of impressive murals created by the famous Mexican muralist Diego Rivera. These murals, titled "Water, the Origin of Life," tell the story of water in Mexico, from pre-Hispanic times to modernity. 

The next visit will be Chapultepec Castle, built in the eighteenth century as the summer residence of the Spanish Viceroy, with its stunning neoclassical architecture and panoramic location, Chapultepec Castle is an important symbol of Mexican history and culture. 

In the afternoon, we will visit the National Museum of Anthropology, which is one of the most recognized museums in the world, it houses an exceptional collection of archaeological, ethnographic and artistic objects from Mexico's indigenous cultures. 

We will end the day by attending a wrestling show at the famous Arena Mexico, wrestling is a sport that combines athletic prowess, acrobatics and theatrical drama.
